known_limits: R01 still mounts the editor with map=null if the cabinet is opened before the map is ready; drawing then stays off until reopen. Fixed on the editor side (map getter, setMap) but needs a one-line R01 change (INTEGRATION.txt 1a).
R03 still handles its own map clicks while the editor draws (a click on a public object also selects it) and its hover resets the crosshair cursor (INTEGRATION.txt 2).
One local 'new record' copy per tab; logout clears all local copies of this tab.
Existing lines/areas cannot be edited vertex by vertex; they are redrawn.
No address/street search inside the cabinet; the place is marked on the map or typed as coordinates.
The resident preview is the editor's own rendering; some labels differ from R03's resident card.
Status/date contradictions (e.g. 'in progress' with a past deadline) are warnings, not errors.
Client limits and enums duplicate R02's validate.py because /staff/meta is not routed by the R01 gateway.
next_step: R01: pass the map to the editor as a getter (openEditor: map: () => currentMap()) or call S.mounted.editor?.setMap?.(currentMap()) in onMapReady, then re-run R04_APP=1 node --test tests/civic/R04/app_acceptance.test.cjs with the cabinet opened before the map loads.
